name: Loan Interest Rates
description: Interest rates (%) on 50 loans from Lending Club. Use to build a bootstrap CI for the mean rate.
studyDescription: Interest rates assigned to 50 loans from the Lending Club peer-to-peer lending platform. Interest rates were determined by Lending Club based on borrower creditworthiness and loan characteristics. This is an observational study based on a random sample of funded loans.

variableDescriptions.interest_rate: Annual interest rate on the loan as a percentage

sourceDetail: OpenIntro IMS Ch. 12. Data from the openintro R package (loan50). Original data from the Lending Club public loan database.
